outcome: Spontaneous vaginal delivery ≥40 weeks of gestation
Diagnostic accuracy of ultrasound in predicting delivery ≥40 weeks of gestation
cohort: 518 singleton pregnancies of parous women undergoing ultrasound assessment at 36-38 weeks of gestation
finding: Cervical length at 36-38 weeks of gestation was the strongest predictor of spontaneous vaginal delivery at or after 40 weeks.
